text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B, C, and E after gains felt rewarding, but I should base future sales on the outlook and my plan, not the pleasure of locking in a profit.","I bought Stock E and later Stock B at higher prices; I should avoid chasing recent price moves and check whether a purchase fits my goals and available cash.","With few trades and mixed monthly returns, patience suits my habits; I should review my holdings periodically and avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations."]}
